plan.notes: Source: UACCB 2026-2027 College Catalog, Health Professions section, Certificate of Proficiency Health Professions. Genuine 'Suggested Course Sequence' published as a single Fall-or-Spring term (3+3+3+1+3+3 = 16) matching the stated credential total 16. Math and Science slots are modeled as choice slots with the first-listed course from each official requirements list as the code. The two 'Elective Option' slots draw from the 6-credit Program Electives pool (ALHE 10503, ALHE 11043, BUSI 10663, PSYC 11003, SOCI 10103, SPCH 10003, UNIV 10173) -- the catalog does not assign courses to the slots, so generic ELECTIVE placeholders are used (not invented).
